tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral gyi phrin las kyi rim pa dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog gshin rje'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi byed po gcig nyid kyis// log 'dren ma lus tshar gcod cing*// dam can skyong ba lhan cig po// byed pa de la bdag dga'o// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gzhol ba'i sgrub pa pos gnas dur khrod la sogs las dang mthun par/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mdun du/ 'bru sna'i gtor ma bra nag gi dbyibs can lta bu la 'khor gru gsum bzhis bskor ba'i mtshams rnams su ong skyu bcad kha phyir bstan gyis bskor ba sha khrag gis sbyar zhing gdugs mthing nag gis spras pa bshams/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka dang*/ mdun du khrag chen gyi ar+ghaṃ/ zhag chen gyi zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen gu gul dang sbyar ba'i spos/ mi rta nya'i zhun gyi mar me/ mkhris chen chang gis sbags pa'i dri chab/ sha rus 'bru nag gi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo rnams bshams/ gzhan yang tsan+dan gyi beng*/ lcags par/ go mtshon/ dar dpyangs sna tshogs pa'i spyan gzigs/ phyi rten lug nag /g.yag nag rgyan gyis spras pa/ nang rten bya rog gi gsob/ gsang rten gri snying chas su bcug pa sogs dang*/ bskang ba nas bshad pa'i yo byad rnams kyang ji ltar 'byor ba bkod legs par bshams/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug /skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar gsal bar gyur/ ces rang gi yi dam gang yin gsal btab/ bdud rtsi/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam gyi steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ kaṃ las thod skam gyi sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi dbus su mū las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du bi las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

lhor ra las rak+ta trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu shu las byang sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du ma las klad pa khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar lhor go las ba glang gi sha lāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ nub byang du ha la glang po che'i sha pāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang shar du ta las rta'i sha tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bas dri ma sbyangs/ steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing ga brtsegs te gnas pa las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim zhing yi ge gsum yang bdud rtsir zhu ba 'dres pa zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ rak+ta bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i thod rlon khrag dang zhag 'dzag pa'i nang du baṃ gyi snying khrag dang*/ pad+ma rak+ta yongs su rdzogs pa sogs bcud kyi rak+ta khrag chen gyi rgya mtsho'i lbu 'phreng rba rlabs phyogs thams cad du 'khrugs shing g.yo ba zag pa med pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs bdud rtsi ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ hūm̐ las byung ba phyugs chen khrag gi mchod yon/ zhag chen dang chu ser gyi zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen gu gul sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ mkhris chen chang gis sbags pa'i dri chab/ sha rus 'bru nag gi bshos bu/ thod rnga rkang gling gi rol mo rnams dang*/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i khams kun tu khyab pa mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes pa bskyed nus pas yongs su gang bar gyur/

oṃ ma hā sh+ma shān ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shapad= oṃ sarba bid+yā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes byin brlabs la/ sngon gtor gsum byin brlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi bdag khyad par sa phyogs dang yul phyogs 'di'i gnas bdag ma lus pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka la sogs pa gnod byed bgegs rigs lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la sbyin no// dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams gtor mas tshims nas byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /nag po'i phyogs rnams gtor ma khyer nas bdag cag nag po chen po sgrub pa la bar gcod ma bgyid par rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs zhes brjod/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las hūm̐ yig mang po phyogs bcur 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dang*/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang*/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bre/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje mda'i dra ba bar med du khyab pa sra zhing mkhregs pa'i phyi rol du/ rdo rje ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar zhing g.yas su 'khor bar 'ur chom tsheg phaṭa hūm̐ sod kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrog cing me'i tsha tsha phyogs thams cad du 'phro bas/ log par lta ba'i bgegs thams cad brlag cing bsregs la tshar gcod pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ mdun bskyed ni/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i mdun du bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me dpung lta bu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung zhing yangs pa'i dbus su/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab nag po khrag dang zhag gi zham chu nag po 'bab cing mche ris can gyi steng du/ mi ro 'bum gcal du bkram zhing*/ rta ro 'bum khrir brtsegs pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dmar nag nyi ma ltar 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus la bstims/ slar 'od zer mtshon cha'i rnam pa can 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can gyi log par lta ba tshar bcad/ bstan pa la bkod/ ma 'khod pa rnams bsgral/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs can zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs ljags 'dril drag po'i rkan sgra dang ru ta ru ta zhes brjod pas lha ma yin gyi g.yul ngo zlog pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum skar chen lta bur 'khrug pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom rnams dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag 'bar ba gyen du brdzes pa'i khrod du rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin pū ri dkar pos brgyan pa/ sbrul nag gyi cod pan 'chang ba snyan cha rin chen 'khor los spras pa/ sku la dar mthing gi 'jol ber dgu brtsegs lhab lhub tu gsol ba'i steng du gser gyi ska rags bcings pa/ zhabs la sag chen yu ring khra bo mnabs pa/ phyag gnyis tsan+dan gyi beng chen 'phyar stabs su bsnams pas lha bdud kyi dmag bye ba dung phyur 'gyed pa/ thod pa skam po lnga rin po che'i rtse phran can skra mtshams su bcings shing ber nag gi steng du mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa rgyu ma'i thag pas skra gseb tu sbrel ba'i do shal 'phyang ba/

yan lag mched bzhi sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su dpa' bo'i dor stabs tshul du bzhengs pa/ bdud nag nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas bskor ba/ de'i g.yon du rlung nag 'tshub ma dgu klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus su mgyogs byed rnga mong gwa pa'i steng du bh+yoḥlas srin mo nam mkha'i khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma bdud kyi yum gshin rje'i lcam gcig sku mdog dmar skya/ zla ba tshes pa lta bu'i zhal can/ sku la mi lpags stong gi slog pa gsol ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi phreng ba 'dzin pas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba/ g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams nas bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra la nad sna tshogs kyi char rgyun 'bebs pa ma mo 'bum gyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la bh+yoḥlas lha mo zor ba can sku mdog dmar mo g.yas zor ba g.yon zhags pa dmar po 'dzin pa/ gcer mo skra gzengs pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma ro'i steng du baṃ las bal mo nag mo g.yas mchog phur dang*/ g.yon phu dung 'dzin pa/ gcer mo skra grol phyag rgya lngas spras pa g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa de gnyis ka la rang 'dra'i khro mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mdun du hūm̐ las bdud mgon nag po stobs chen dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol ba/ g.yas ral gri zangs yag gdengs shing g.yon bdud kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ bdud rta nag po la bcibs pa/ stag gzig khyi brgya phyi nas 'brangs pa/ lcags kyi bya khra brgyad sna la phur ba/ lcags kyi spyang ki sngon mo g.yas su rgyug cing*/ zangs kyi 'phar ba dmar po g.yon du 'phyo ba/ bdud rol pa skya brgyad dang*/ ya bdud bye ba dung phyur gyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang gtso bo'i 'khor sna tshogs mgyogs kyi pho nya gnod sbyin seng mgo/ tsit+ta sngags rgod/ shan pa lag dmar la sogs pa snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/

de ltar gsal ba'i gtso bo thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ bdag dang mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rang bzhin dag pa chos kyi dbyings dang*/ 'og min gyi gnas dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ sgrub gnas gnyan po rnams dang*/ dur khrod brgyad la sogs pa nas dpal nag po chen po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig la char sprin gtibs pa dang myur mgyogs glog 'khyugs pa ltar spyan drangs bar bsam/ sbyar ba'i spos bsregs/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas rngam pa'i nga ros spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings 'dus ma byas// 'og min lhun rdzogs rngam pa'i zhing khams nas// lha chen dpal 'bar tsan+dan beng chen sku// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can stobs bcu mnga' ba po// rngam pa'i nga ros ma rungs skrag par byed// srid gsum mnga' ba log 'dren bdud dpung 'joms// bstan pa srung zhing dgra bgegs bsgral slad du// rnal 'byor dam ldan mos pas spyan 'dren na| |lcam dral 'khor bcas gnas 'dir da tshur byon// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol/ */oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā lā sa ma ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ mi 'gyur rdo rje brag chen rngam pa'i steng*// pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng*// rab brjid 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa na// mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes shing ci bder bzhugs// oṃ ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra traka rak+sha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi mgor rdo rje bzhag /lce la bdud rtsi sbyin la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */

sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas// nag po khyod rnams 'dul ba'i tshe// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// rnal 'byor skyong zhing dgra bgegs sgrol// dkar phyogs skyong bar ma chad dam// sngon tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa// ma bsnyel dus 'dir dran mdzod la// sngags 'chang bdag gi re ba skong*// gal te dam las khyod 'gal na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas| |chad pa dam tshig rdo rje yis// khyod kyi lus sems brlags byas nas// rdo rje'i dmyal bar shi ka re// de bas dam srungs phrin las sgrubs// oṃ ma hā kā lā badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu a mṛ ta na rak+kan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ gdod nas rang sems lhar dag kyang*// kun rdzob snang ngor bdag cag gi// lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis// srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ma hā kā lā na mo na maḥ mchod pa ni/ haṃ'u */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// snying khrag dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dang*// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// zhag dang chu ser zhabs bsil 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// sha chen 'dre 'jigs bdug pa 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// tshil chen zhun gyi snang gsal 'di| |legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// mkhris chen chang sbyar dri chab 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// sha rus pags pa bza' ba 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul| |bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs rnams ni rab bsgral ba'i// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'di// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sh+ma shān shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas la// gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon dang*// gtsang sbyar dag pa'i zhabs bsil dang*// chu dang thang skyes me tog tshogs| |sbyar dang rang byung spos kyi mchog /'bru mar rtsi mar snang gsal dang*// ga pur la sogs dri yi khyab// ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas dang*// rol mo glu+u dbyangs mchod pa 'bul| |oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa ni| |mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// bsung ba'i dri dang bda' ba'i ro// 'jam pa'i reg bya 'bul gyi bzhes// oṃ badz+ra rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */

lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la// nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dri chen dri chu khrag byang sems// go ro tsa na bdud rtsi lnga// mi sha rta sha ba glang sha// glang chen sha dang khyi yi sha| |sha sna lnga yi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ badz+ra pañtsa maṃ sa a mṛ ta= hūm̐ */ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la// gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bde chen dga' skyed na chung ma// dpal 'bar khro mo'i tshul gyis ni// sku la 'khril zhing sbyor ba las// snyoms 'jug 'dzag med dga' ba bzhi// bde stong ngang du dgyes par rol// oṃ a nu rā ga ṇa= hūm̐ */ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la// don dam bden pa'i mchod pa ni// 'khor gsum dmigs pa dang bral ba// gzod nas dag pa'i ngo bo nyid// dmigs med phyag rgya chen po ste// mchod bya mchod byed kyis stong pa// 'bul bya 'bul byed med par 'bul// bstsal bya stsol byed med pa yi// 'grub bya 'grub byed med par stsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā mu dra= zhes dang*/ yang*/ hūm̐ */ mtshan ldan bhan+dhar rtsa brgyad yan lag stong*// zag med bdud rtsi rigs lnga yum lnga dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs dngos grub sgrub pa'i rdzas// 'chi med ra sa ya na'i mchod pa ni// thub dbang 'char ka rgyal po sprin gyi shugs// dge ba'i go cha gsal ba'i tshul khrims dang*// gsal ba'i blon po shes rab rin chen zhabs// khams ston chos rje dpal ldan tre bo mgon// yon tan grags pa gcung gzhon rgyal ba grags// bla chen grags rgyal shes rab blo gros dang*// byang sems gzhon dpal bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang*// theg chen grags gzhon bkra shis rin chen pa// chos lung grags bzang ye shes 'od zer mtshan// grags pa rgyal mtshan grags pa rin chen pa// dpal 'byor grags pa chos dbang grags pa dang*| |'jam dbyangs rin chen rin chen dpal 'byor grags// phun tshogs rnam grags karma ngag dbang sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

theg pa rim dgu bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud// rnal 'byor bla med pha ma gnyis med sogs// gsang sngags gsar snying sngags gzhung rgya mtsho che'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las pa// sangs rgyas bstan srung rnal 'byor dam ldan skyong*// dam nyams gdug byed dgra bgegs kun sgrol ba// beng chen mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yum chen nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang mo dang*// zor ba can dang bal mo nag mo dang*// bdud mgon nag po stobs can rang 'khor bcas// dam can srung ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rno mgyogs pho nya gnod sbyin seng mgo dang*// tsit+ta sngags rgod bshan pa lag dmar sogs// sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs lha srin sde brgyad bcas// sprul pa yang sprul zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi thigs gtor 'bul zhing gtor mar sgron/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hoḥ mtshan ldan bhan+dha'i snod chen du// ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho che// mtheb srin nyi zla sbyar ba yis// ljags su bstar na dngos grub stsol| |oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sa yā na sarba sid+dhi pha la pra yats+tsha a la la hoḥ zhes rang gis bdud rtsi myang*/ rak+ta brlabs shing*/ hūm̐ */ mi mgo rlon pa'i snod yangs par// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag dang*// bam chen gsang ba'i rak+ta dang*// pad+ma rak+ta la sogs pa// rgyu rkyen sna tshogs rab sbyar ba// dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho che// dba' rlabs stong gsum khyab par 'khrugs// lbu phreng srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyo// 'dod yon longs spyod kun gyi gter// rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di// ma hā kā lā khrag 'thung dpal// lha chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes gtor mar sgron/

/chos nyid don ldan 'gro la bu ltar brtse// lha yi dmag dpon rnal 'byor kun gyi grogs// lha chen nag po khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ g.yon na thugs dam dgyes skong gsang ba'i yum// nam mkha'i khams kyi dbang mo dbyings phyug ma// gser phreng nad rkyal thogs nas rnga mo zhon// zla tshes zhal mnga' mi lpags slog pa gsol// bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma// drag mo mi sdug gzugs 'chang yum la bstod// hūm̐ */ rgyab na lha mo 'jigs ma zor ba can// sku mdog dmar rngam zor ba zhags pa 'dzin| |nam mkha'i gos can phyag rgya rnam lngas spras// khro mo 'bar ba'i sku la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ g.yas na bal mo nag mo mi sdug ma// g.yas kyi phyag na mchod rten phur pa gdengs| |g.yon na phu dung 'dzin cing dgra la rdeb// g.yon brkyang gar can khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ mdun na bdud mgon nag po stobs chen ni// ral gri zhags pa thogs nas bdud rta zhon// stag gzig khyi bya 'phar spyang rol du khrid// stobs chen bdud kyi gtso la bdag bstod do// hūm̐ */ beng chen lcam dral bka' 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs| |bdud dang ya bdud dmag tshogs bye ba dung*// rno mgyogs pho nya gnod sbyin seng mgo dang*// tsit+ta sngags rgod shan pa lag dmar sogs// snang srid lha srin pho mo dregs pa'i tshogs| |phyogs skyong rgyal chen lha chen brgyad dang bcas// gnod sbyin 'byung po ma rungs klu dang bcas// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro ma mo sde brgyad tshogs// bka' gnyan sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul tshogs// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan srung rnal 'byor stongs grogs mdzod// sdang ba'i dgra sod gnod pa'i bgegs dpung thul// zhi rgyas dbang drag bcol ba'i las kun mdzod// ces gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bstod pa dang*/

gzhan yang yab kyi mkhar bstod dang*/ yum gyi gur bstod kyang skabs 'dir bya ba gal che'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ dung chen nam/ rak+sha'am/ lung thang gi bgrang phreng sngon du gzhan gyis longs ma spyad pa dri chus bkrus/ sha chen dang gu gul gyis bdug la/ mgon po gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ yig dmar nag nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar ba la nye snying dang*/ snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa la phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sngon rdo rje 'chang dang thub pa'i dbang po dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa thams cad la bsnyel ba med par dran nas bdag gi phrin las gang bcol thogs pa med par mdzad par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā du beṃ ni dza go na ru tra rak+sha re ma ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so// sha shog /her ni shog /her ma thum/ ril shog /der shog /'dir shog /'dir thuṃ/ 'dir thuṃ/ tsit+ta baṃ/ tsit+ta rbad/ snying po'o// oṃ ma hā kā lā kā la rū pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ nye snying ngo*// de ltar rtsa sngags la 'bum phrag gsum/ snying po dang nye snying la 'bum mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla dgos so// 'khor gyi bzlas pa ni/ 'khor bzhi'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gdan la yum dang zor ba can la bh+yo re re/ bal mo la maṃ/ gur mgon la hūm̐ rnams rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i mthar rang sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros mgon po'i thugs srog la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par gyur par bsam la/ traka rak+sha sha ta hri/ traka rak+sha rak+mo/ yum mo// oṃ ma hā kā lī dun+tiṃ rak+mo kha la ma hi dzaḥ zor can no// mu na rak+sha dza mu na kha bya rbad/ traka rak+sha kha thuṃ kha thuṃ rbad rbad dza dzaḥ

bal mo'o// ma hā kā lā ya to ya phaṭa ya to ya khug /ni ka ta ya ni ka ta ya/ bhe dze bhe dze/ saṃ bhe dze saṃ bhe dze/ zhes pa nag po stobs chen no// de ltar 'khor bzhi po khri khrag re/ gtso 'khor thun mong du/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na zhes pa nas mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sngags ring gong du gtor bsngos kyi skabs bshad par ltar 'bum phrag tsam bzla ba'ang gal che'o// thun mtshams su tshogs mchod bya ba ni/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bza' btung sna tshogs pa bshams/ me rlung chus sbyangs shing*/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs srog sa bon las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros tshogs kyi dri ma dang*// 'bag btsog dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bag chags rnams// ye shes mes sreg 'byung ba rlung gis gtor// sbyong byed chus bkrus rab gtsang dag par gyur// ces dang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid lha yi thugs srog las// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥ */dkar dmar mthing ga rab 'phros pa// tshogs la rim gyis thim pa'i tshe// gti mug las gyur tshogs rdzas rnams// dkar po sku yi rdo rje ste// 'dod chags rdzas rnams dmar po la// gsung gi rdo rje'i rang bzhin can// zhe sdang rdzas rnams mthing ga ste// thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin can// zag med bde chen bdud rtsir gyur// de dag sbyangs shing du mar spel| |ye shes bdud rtsir sbyangs byas nas// lha rnams dgyes skong dam par gyur// ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ tshogs phud dang po dang sman raka gtor mar sgron la/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs// beng chen mgon po lcam dral sprul 'khor bcas// dam can rgya mtsho lha srin dregs pa rnams// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs| |bza' bca' btung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// thabs shes dbyer med longs spyod dam tshig rdzas// ga ṇa tsakra'i dga' ston 'bul gyi bzhes// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

gnyis pa sgron la/ hūm̐ */ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di// ma tshang med pa dgos dgu kun grub ste// sreg sbyang gtor zhing sku gsung thugs rdo rjer// byin brlabs sbyangs spel sbar ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// bla ma yi dam ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dang*// ma hā kā lā beng 'dzin 'khor bcas la// 'bul gyi bzhes la thugs dam gnyan po skongs// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi// dam tshig 'gal 'das bdag gnong gang bgyis pa// mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ tha ma rak+ta bran/ 'gugs 'dren lan gsum sogs kyi mthar/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ /thugs las 'gugs sgrol pho nya sprul// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// thogs pa'i pho nyas dgra dang bgegs| |bar gcod dam sri 'byung po rnams// snying phug yan lag dam por chings// ske nas khrid cing rgyab nas phud// gzugs ling 'di la khug la shog /lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod// rang gshed bdud bzhi nang nas slong*// thun phur mtshon chas phyi nas rdeg /srog gcod dbugs long lus sems phrol// rnam shes bde chen gnas su spor// phung khams skye mched sha khrag rus// 'byung ba lnga po la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du 'bul// yi dam zhi khro'i zhal du 'bul// ma sring mkha' 'gro'i zhal du 'bul// beng chen mgon po'i zhal du 'bul// yum chen sring mo'i zhal du 'bul// zor ba thogs pa'i zhal du 'bul// bal mo nag mo'i zhal du 'bul// nag po stobs chen zhal du 'bul// 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhal du 'bul// dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du 'bul// gsol lo rol cig kha raṃkhā hi// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra sha trūṃ ma hā maṃ sa kha raṃ khā hi/

rak+ta= tsit+ta= ba su ta= go ro tsa na= keṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes bsgral nas gtor ma la bstab/ skabs 'dir bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can| |dam la gnas shing lha la 'phreng*// khyod ni srung ma mthu rtsal can// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs khyod kyis dam bcas pas// da lta rnal 'byor brjed bskul ni// sgrub cing bskul phyir gshegs su gsol// bos so mgon po snyan ma sra// g.yab bo bdud rgyal spyan ma rtul// bsten no lha chen rgyang ma ring*// sgrub bo nag po gong ma g.yel// bskur ro beng 'dzin phrag ma dog /rbad do legs ldan mthu ma chung*// bskul lo dam can bang ma bul// do nub thugs dam gnyan po skong*// do nub mna' chad tho la byon// grogs por byas so gzhung ma ring*// mdza' bor byon no ngo ma dor// mna' tho chad la mna' ma za// jo bor bya'o dbang ma che// bran ltar bskul lo rgyud ma ngan// khyod dang sngags 'chang bdag nyid dag /bskal pa zhig kyang mi 'bral lo// khyod kyang dam las ma 'da' zhig /bdag kyang dam las mi 'da' 'o// gnyis ka dam las 'da' mi 'tshal// rgyal ba'i bka' la mi nyan med// zab mo'i don la mi sems med// mna' tho chad la mi nyan med// zas dang skom la mi sems med// nor dang rdzas la mi rkam med// khyod la mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni// dka' ba srog dang bsdos nas btsal// de phyir de la dgongs par mdzod// kye/ grogs la gzhung med mi srid kyi// byams la drin med mi srid kyi// mdza' la gdong med mi srid kyi// rnal 'byor dam med mi srid kyi// chos skyong mthu med mi srid kyi// dgyes pa'i mchod pa bdag gis 'bul// de yi ngo dpal khyod kyis gyis// chad pa'i gzhung zhig ngas kyang bsrang*// smras pa'i tshig kyang khyod kyis nyon// bskul ba'i gnyer kha nga la yod// bcol ba'i las sgrub khyod bab ste// ltem me rgyang nge ma mdzad par// brtse gdung gdung sems ci cher mdzod// le lo snyoms las ma mdzad par// brtson pas bdag gi grogs mdzod cig
